reason: Class reps and seniors already forward every deadline and exam notice to our WhatsApp groups, and I barely open my college Outlook, so an app built on top of official announcements is one more thing I'd forget about. I might install it if the uni pushes it, but I wouldn't still be opening it every week a month later.
objection: Everything I actually need already reaches me on WhatsApp, usually faster and with context from friends. The stuff I care about most, like clubs, fests and events, isn't even in it yet.
would_change_my_mind: If clubs, fests and event updates were in it from day one and my friends and clubs actually used it instead of WhatsApp.
